text: dsh-eval-harness 是面向 AI 与 Agent 应用开发的 DSH 技能包，通过注册 ai-eval-harness 技能向 agent 提供评测方法和配套资产。它包含 RAG 检索指标计算、离线与在线评测设计、结果分片和基线回归比较等内容，并强调用标注数据和外部事实支撑判定。适合需要衡量 RAG、工具调用或提示词改动效果的开发者；RAG 指标脚本读取由使用者准备的检索结果与期望文档，在线评测接口也需按项目适配。通过 DSH 插件命令安装后，技能由 ctx.skills 提供。

dsh-eval-harness is a DSH skill bundle for AI and agent evaluation. It registers a skill with RAG metrics, evaluation guidance, result shards, and regression baselines. Use it to measure retrieval changes with user-supplied expected and retrieved documents. Online interfaces need adaptation.
我想给自己的 Agent 应用搭一套可复现的评测流程。
怎么比较 RAG 检索改动前后的命中率和排序质量？
I need a repeatable way to compare evaluation results against a baseline.
dsh-eval-harness 的功能「RAG 检索指标」：对期望文档 ID 与检索结果计算 Recall@K、Precision@K、MRR 和 nDCG@K，并可输出完全命中数供基线比较。将检索结果写入数据集后即可按命令行参数计算。
dsh-eval-harness 的功能「评测结果分片」：将套件名称、通过数、总数和失败信息写成 JSON 结果文件；在线结果可记录 live 或 live-strict 类型，供后续基线比较读取。

面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 **Agent 应用程序开发评测技能**（skill bundle，技能包）。核心不是跑分，而是**让每个数字都可复现、可比较、且不骗人**：判定依据必须来自外部事实（审计表、服务端结构化结果、确定性规则），判据必须双向（该答未答 / 不该答却答了），并且用变异测试证明评测器自己没坏。覆盖 RAG 检索、工具调用、提示词安全与多轮对话的评测设计。

dsh-eval-harness README · 已知边界：- `eval_online.py` 是**骨架**：`login()` / `chat()` / `tool_calls_of()` 需按你的项目契约改写；数据集样例是 `<占位符>` 格式样板，换项目必须整体替换。
- 判定逻辑的回归自检 monkeypatch 模块级函数，验证的是判定纪律，不是真实网络路径；真实连通性仍需跑一次在线评测。
- `EvalResults.java` 已进 `npm test` 自动门禁（javac 编译 + 运行 + 与 Python 侧 JSON 形状比对）；`install.ps1` 的安装分支仍需在有仓库副本的环境里手动 `install.ps1 -VerifyOnly`。
- `eval_rag.py` / `eval_rag_answer.py` 不连接任何检索或生成服务：`retrieved` 列表、`supportFacts` / `citations` / `requiredPoints` 等标注对由你的系统导出或人工标注，指标计算只对外部事实负责。
- 本仓库自身的 CI 在 [.github/workflows/eval-gate.yml](.github/workflows/eval-gate.yml)（真实执行：自检 + 变异 + Java 冒烟 + 数据集治理）；`assets/ci-eval.yml.example` 是给接入方的模板。
- 整句语义相似度、答案是否"自然"等判断不在这套工具内——它们需要模型互评或人工评审，按第一原则不进门禁；`eval_governance.py judge` 只负责校准 Judge 是否够格当**辅助分**。
- 多轮套件与工具五阶段的**判据设计**已实现（见 `run_multi_turn_suite` / `check_tool_stages`），但对应数据集样例需按你的业务改写；`tool_call_records()` 的完整副作用记录接口需按项目审计表对接。

dsh-eval-harness README · dsh-eval-harness：An **agent application development evaluation skill** (skill bundle) for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). The point is not to produce scores but to make **every number reproducible, comparable, and honest**: judgments come from external facts (audit tables, server-side structured results, deterministic rules), criteria are bidirectional (should-have-answered vs. should-not-have-answered), and mutation tests prove the evaluators themselves catch regressions. Covers RAG retrieval, tool calls, prompt safety, and multi-turn evaluation design.

dsh-eval-harness README · dsh-eval-harness：> **Form factor**: this repo is a **skill bundle** — `dsh.bundle` registers `skills/ai-eval-harness/SKILL.md` into `ctx.skills` as a bundled provider, so an agent loads the methodology and asset scripts. It is **not a host feature plugin**: no `dsh.client`, no host UI/commands, no runtime code injection.
>
> **Host requirements are deliberately undeclared**: `package.json` intentionally omits `dsh.compatibility.dsh`. This bundle only uses the public skill-registration interface and has not been tested across multiple DSH host versions, so no compatibility range is guessed or claimed. `engines.node >= 20` is a build/CI requirement for this repo only, **not** a DSH host version requirement; add `dsh.compatibility.dsh` yourself only after testing on your target host version.

dsh-eval-harness README · When to use：| scenario | what it does for you |
|---|---|
| building quality metrics for an LLM/agent app | stand up the three-layer loop: offline assertions + online model-in-the-loop + baseline diff |
| proving a RAG / tool / prompt change did not regress | compare case-by-case against the baseline; any drop goes red, safety regressions have zero tolerance |
| evals are green but users still hit failures | walk the four-trap catalog and the root-cause layers to find the false green |
| suspecting your eval script lies to itself | run `mutation_check.py`: break the implementation, see whether the assertions dare to go red |
| numbers "look right" but you cannot trust them | five-state result contract, denominator discipline, small-n annotations 鈥?every number explains itself |

dsh-eval-harness README · Known limits：- `eval_online.py` is a **skeleton**: rewrite `login()` / `chat()` / `tool_calls_of()` for your project contract; the sample datasets are `<placeholder>` format templates and must be replaced wholesale.
- The self-test monkeypatches module-level functions; it validates the judging discipline, not real network paths — a real online run is still needed.
- `EvalResults.java` is verified by `npm test` (javac compile + run + JSON-shape check against Python). `install.ps1`'s install branch still needs a manual `install.ps1 -VerifyOnly` in an environment that has the repo copy.
- `eval_rag.py` / `eval_rag_answer.py` do not talk to any retrieval or generation service: `retrieved` lists and `supportFacts` / `citations` / `requiredPoints` annotation pairs are exported by your system or labeled by humans; the metrics only judge those external facts.
- This repo runs its own CI at [.github/workflows/eval-gate.yml](.github/workflows/eval-gate.yml) (selftest + mutation + Java smoke + dataset governance, really executed); `assets/ci-eval.yml.example` is a template for adopters.
- Sentence-level semantic similarity and "naturalness" are outside this toolkit —
